name: OlogyCrew
description: Marketplace for discovering service providers and preparing customer-reviewed booking or quote handoffs.

search_services.description: Search active non-demo services by keyword, category, provider location, or public price. Set includeDemo=true to include official demos, labeled isDemo=true after real providers.

get_provider.description: Read an active provider's public profile, trust context, categories, and services.

check_availability.description: Get service-duration-specific available starts without exposing booking details or creating a hold.

prepare_review_handoff.description: Prepare a 30-minute encrypted URL that preloads OlogyCrew's existing booking-or-quote review flow.

list_categories.description: List active service categories with active-service counts.
